blocks.content: Desertification refers to land degradation in arid and semi-arid regions due to climatic variations and human activities such as overgrazing, deforestation, and improper irrigation.

items: Remember that desertification specifically targets arid and semi-arid regions.
Be prepared to list the three primary human drivers: overgrazing, deforestation, and improper irrigation.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Desertification is defined as land degradation occurring in arid and semi-arid regions.
The process is triggered by both natural climatic variations and anthropogenic (human) activities.
Key human activities contributing to land degradation include overgrazing, deforestation, and improper irrigation.
